title: Pz的碎碎念
subTitle: 在坚冰还盖着北海的时候我看到了怒放的梅花
script:
<script>
(function(){
  var postBody=document.getElementById("postBody");
  if(!postBody)return;
  var text=postBody.innerText||"";
  var count=text.replace(/\s/g,"").length;
  var minutes=Math.ceil(count/400);
  var div=document.createElement("div");
  div.style.cssText="font-size:13px;color:#888;margin-top:24px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #eee;text-align:right;";
  div.innerText="字数统计："+count+" 字 · 预计阅读："+minutes+" 分钟";
  postBody.parentNode.insertBefore(div,postBody.nextSibling);
  var btn=document.createElement("div");
  btn.innerHTML="↑";
  btn.style.cssText="position:fixed;right:24px;bottom:24px;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:#333;color:#fff;font-size:22px;text-align:center;line-height:44px;cursor:pointer;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);z-index:999;user-select:none;";
  btn.onmouseover=function(){btn.style.background="#555"};
  btn.onmouseout=function(){btn.style.background="#333"};
  btn.onclick=function(){window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"smooth"})};
  document.body.appendChild(btn);
  window.addEventListener("scroll",function(){btn.style.opacity=window.scrollY>300?"0.85":"0"});
})();
</script>
